newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's public sector debt up 0.9 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's public sector debt up 0.9 pct in March.

text.p: Ecuador's public sector debt rose 0.9 percent in March compared to April to stand at $12.5 billion, the Central Bank said Thursday.
However, in March the public sector debt accounted for 64.75 percent of gross domestic product compared to 65.18 percent a year earlier.
Expenditures in March were worth $240 million while amortizations totaled $150.5 million and public debt interests totaled $235.3 million.
The private foreign debt in March was $2.0 billion compared to $1.7 billion in March 1996, leading to a total foreign debt of $14.6 million in March.
